Install and update this workflow with `aardvark install_alfred`, which also records where the `aardvark` command lives on this Mac. Remove it with `aardvark install_alfred --uninstall`.
Two settings are configurable: the terminal app the ⌥ handoff opens, and an explicit path to the `aardvark` command if the recorded one is ever wrong.
The app the ⌥ handoff opens a tab in. Left empty, iTerm is used when installed and Terminal otherwise.
An explicit path to the `aardvark` command, overriding the one `aardvark install_alfred` recorded. Left empty, the recorded path is used.
